articles.title_cn: 碳抵消是否真正抵消了碳排放？
articles.abstract_en: We develop and implement a new method for identifying wasted subsidies and use it to provide systematic evidence of the misallocation of carbon offsets in the Clean Development Mechanism—the world's largest carbon offset program. Using newly constructed data on the locations and characteristics of over 1,000 wind farms in India, we estimate that at least 52 percent of approved carbon offsets were allocated to projects that would very likely have been built anyway. We estimate that the sale of these offsets to regulated polluters resulted in substantially higher global carbon dioxide emissions.(JEL H23, O13, Q42, Q54, Q58)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发并实施了一种识别浪费性补贴的新方法，并利用该方法提供了清洁发展机制——全球最大的碳抵消计划——中碳抵消配置不当的系统性证据。利用我们新构建的关于印度超过1,000个风电场位置和特征的数据，我们估计至少有52%的已批准碳抵消被分配给了那些即使没有碳抵消也很可能建成的项目。我们估计，将这些抵消出售给受监管的污染者导致了全球二氧化碳排放量显著增加。(JEL H23, O13, Q42, Q54, Q58)

articles.title_en: The Simpler the Better? Threshold Effects of Energy Labels on Property Prices and Energy Efficiency Investments
articles.title_cn: 越简单越好？能源标签对房产价格和能效投资的阈值效应
articles.abstract_en: Using British data on over 7 million residential property sales, we find that the simplified energy efficiency (EE) information leads to important market effects. UK legislation requires the use of an energy label that shows an EE rating score (1–100) mapped into arbitrary color-coded rating bands (A–G). Applying a regression discontinuity design, we document significant price discontinuities at rating band thresholds, indicating heuristic thinking in the market. These price discontinuities influence market behavior as sellers are more likely to make EE investments if their property is just below a threshold. We discuss policy considerations and avenues for future research. (JEL D91, K32, Q48, R31)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用英国超过7万套住宅销售的数据，我们发现简化的能效信息导致了重要的市场效应。英国立法要求使用能效标签，显示能效评级分数（1-100），并映射到任意颜色编码的评级带（A-G）。通过应用断点回归设计，我们记录了评级带阈值处的显著价格不连续性，表明市场中存在启发式思维。这些价格不连续性影响市场行为，因为如果房产刚好低于阈值，卖家更有可能进行能效投资。我们讨论了政策考虑和未来研究的途径。（JEL D91, K32, Q48, R31）

articles.title_en: Smart Thermostats, Automation, and Time-Varying Prices
articles.title_cn: 智能恒温器、自动化与时变电价
articles.abstract_en: Can automation complement economic incentives? We explore this question by randomly encouraging households to activate a feature on their existing smart thermostat that automates responsiveness to time-of-use electricity pricing. The feature reduces air conditioning use during the highest-priced afternoon period, raising indoor temperatures above a household's preferred temperature, primarily for customers who are typically home during the day. Customers infrequently override the feature when they experience discomfort, suggesting that they are willing to trade off monetary savings for small increases in discomfort. Automation thus enables low-cost changes in household energy use, with potentially large electricity supply-cost reductions at scale. (JEL D12, D91, L94, L98, Q48)
articles.abstract_cn: 自动化能否补充经济激励？我们通过随机鼓励家庭激活其现有智能恒温器上的一个功能来探索这一问题，该功能自动响应分时电价。该功能在电价最高的下午时段减少空调使用，使室内温度高于家庭偏好的温度，主要影响那些白天通常在家中的客户。当客户感到不适时，他们很少覆盖该功能，这表明他们愿意以轻微的不适增加来换取金钱上的节省。因此，自动化能够实现家庭能源使用的低成本变化，并在规模化应用时可能大幅降低电力供应成本。(JEL D12, D91, L94, L98, Q48)

articles.title_en: The Willingness to Pay for a Cooler Day: Evidence from 50 Years of Major League Baseball Games
articles.title_cn: 为凉爽一天付费的意愿：来自50年大联盟棒球比赛的证据
articles.abstract_en: The climate economy literature has documented adverse effects of extreme temperatures on well-being through mechanisms such as mortality, productivity, and conflict. Impacts due simply to discomfort are less well understood. This paper investigates individuals' valuations of weather using a revealed preference approach. We first quantify the decline in attendance at Major League Baseball games on hot and cold days. Leveraging this finding coupled with the historically informed assumption of a horizontal supply curve, we infer a monetized estimate of the disutility of extreme temperatures. We estimate a $1.53 utility loss per hour of exposure to high temperatures, implying nontrivial aggregate welfare effects. (JEL D12, I31, L83, Q54, Z21)
articles.abstract_cn: 气候经济学文献已记录了极端温度通过死亡率、生产力和冲突等机制对福祉产生的不利影响。仅因不适造成的影响则了解较少。本文采用揭示偏好方法研究个体对天气的估值。我们首先量化了炎热和寒冷天气下大联盟棒球比赛观众人数的下降。利用这一发现，结合基于历史信息的水平供给曲线假设，我们推断出极端温度不适感的货币化估计。我们估计暴露于高温每小时造成1.53美元的效用损失，这意味着不可忽视的总体福利效应。(JEL D12, I31, L83, Q54, Z21)

articles.title_en: Better Alone? Evidence on the Costs of Intermunicipal Cooperation
articles.title_cn: 独自更好？市际合作成本的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides new evidence on why municipalities are often reluctant to integrate. Exploiting a French reform that made inter-municipal cooperation mandatory, I find that municipalities forced to integrate experienced a large increase in construction, consistent with NIMBYism, explaining their resistance and that rural municipalities ended up with fewer local public services. I do not find the same effects for municipalities that had voluntarily integrated prior to the law, while both types of municipality enjoyed similar benefits in terms of public transport and fiscal revenues. These findings support the fact that municipalities resisted to avoid the local costs of integration. (JEL H70, R38, R51, R53, R58)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于为何市政当局常常不愿整合的新证据。利用法国一项使市际合作成为强制性的改革，我发现被迫整合的市政当局经历了建筑活动的显著增加，这与邻避主义（NIMBYism）相符，解释了它们的抵制行为，并且农村市政当局最终获得的本地公共服务较少。对于在法律之前自愿整合的市政当局，我没有发现相同的效应，而两类市政当局在公共交通和财政收入方面享受了类似的益处。这些发现支持了市政当局为避免整合的本地成本而抵制的观点。（JEL H70, R38, R51, R53, R58）

articles.title_en: Rising Import Tariffs, Falling Exports: When Modern Supply Chains Meet Old-Style Protectionism
articles.title_cn: 进口关税上升，出口下降：当现代供应链遭遇旧式保护主义
articles.abstract_en: We examine the impacts of the 2018–2019 US import tariff increases on US exports through the lens of supply chain linkages. Using 2016 confidential firm-trade linked data, we identify exporters who were importing products that eventually faced tariff increases to construct product-level exposure to import tariffs. We find that the most exposed products had lower exports in 2018–2019, with the largest effects in 2019. The decline in exports in 2019 is equivalent to an ad valorem tariff on US exports of 2 percent to 4 percent. (JEL F13, F14, F23, L14)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过供应链关联的视角，考察了2018-2019年美国进口关税上调对美国出口的影响。利用2016年保密的公司-贸易关联数据，我们识别出那些进口最终面临关税上调产品的出口商，以构建产品层面的进口关税暴露度。我们发现，暴露度最高的产品在2018-2019年的出口较低，其中2019年的影响最大。2019年的出口下降相当于对美国出口征收2%至4%的从价关税。(JEL F13, F14, F23, L14)

articles.abstract_en: Firms are increasingly concerned about the resilience of their sales and sourcing decisions. Using administrative data, we show that a temporary disruption in trade due to state border closures in India led to a persistent trade collapse within the country—interstate trade relative to intrastate remains five percent lower even six months after all restrictions were lifted. Reshoring explains this phenomenon as plants more dependent on interstate sales (input-sourcing) shift from inter- to intrastate sales (input-sourcing). State borders rather than distance are salient in explaining the observed substitution. We propose a novel product-level measure that determines the extent of reshoring. (JEL D22, F14, L14, L23, O14, R12)
articles.abstract_cn: 企业日益关注其销售和采购决策的韧性。利用行政数据，我们表明印度因邦边境关闭导致的暂时性贸易中断引发了国内贸易的持续崩溃——在所有限制解除六个月后，邦际贸易相对于邦内贸易仍低百分之五。回流解释了这一现象，因为更依赖邦际销售（投入采购）的工厂从邦际转向邦内销售（投入采购）。邦边境而非距离在解释观察到的替代中起显著作用。我们提出了一种新颖的产品级衡量标准，以确定回流的程度。（JEL D22, F14, L14, L23, O14, R12）

articles.title_en: Staggered Difference-in-Differences in Gravity Settings: Revisiting the Effects of Trade Agreements
articles.title_cn: 引力设定中的交错双重差分：重新审视贸易协定的效应
articles.abstract_en: We nest an extended two-way fixed effect (ETWFE) estimator for staggered difference-in-differences within the structural gravity model. To test the ETWFE, we estimate the effects of regional trade agreements (RTAs). The results suggest that RTA estimates in the current gravity literature may be biased downward (by more than 50 percent in our sample). Sensitivity analyses confirm the robustness of our main findings and demonstrate the applicability of our methods across settings. We expect the ETWFE methods to have significant implications for estimates of other policy variables in the trade literature and for gravity regressions on migration and foreign direct investment. (JEL C23, F14, F15, F16, J82)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在结构引力模型内嵌套了一种用于交错双重差分的扩展双向固定效应（ETWFE）估计器。为检验ETWFE，我们估计了区域贸易协定（RTAs）的效应。结果表明，当前引力文献中的RTA估计可能被低估（在我们的样本中超过50%）。敏感性分析确认了我们主要发现的稳健性，并展示了我们的方法在不同情境下的适用性。我们预期ETWFE方法将对贸易文献中其他政策变量的估计以及关于移民和外国直接投资的引力回归产生显著影响。（JEL C23, F14, F15, F16, J82）

articles.abstract_en: We use linked employer–employee data to study the causal effects of location on earnings in the United States. We estimate a model with employer and employee effects, then aggregate to the commuting zone (CZ) level. Sorting across firms biases traditional “movers” designs. Our model accurately predicts earnings changes for CZ movers after accounting for firm sorting. Worker skills explain half of observed earnings differences across CZs; observable characteristics understate this. Industry composition explains little of average place effects. Costs at least offset CZ earnings premia on average; workers who move to higher-wage CZs have equal or lower real consumption. (JEL J24, J31, R23, R32)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用关联的雇主-雇员数据来研究位置对美国收入的因果效应。我们估计了一个包含雇主和雇员效应的模型，然后汇总到通勤区（CZ）层面。跨企业的分类偏差影响了传统的“流动者”设计。在考虑企业分类后，我们的模型准确预测了CZ流动者的收入变化。工人技能解释了观察到的CZ间收入差异的一半；可观测特征低估了这一比例。行业构成对平均地点效应的解释很少。成本平均至少抵消了CZ收入溢价；迁移到高工资CZ的工人实际消费水平相同或更低。（JEL J24, J31, R23, R32）

articles.title_en: Media Coverage of Immigration and the Polarization of Attitudes
articles.title_cn: 移民的媒体报道与态度的极化
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effect of media coverage on immigration attitudes. It combines data on immigration coverage in French television with individual panel data from 2013 to 2017 that records respondents' preferred television channel and attitudes toward immigration. The analysis focuses on within-individual variations over time, addressing ideological self-selection into channels. We find that increased coverage of immigration polarizes attitudes, with initially moderate individuals becoming more likely to report extremely positive and negative attitudes. This polarization is mainly driven by an increase in the salience of immigration, which reactivates preexisting prejudices, rather than persuasion effects from biased news consumption. (JEL D83, D91, J15, J18, L82)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了媒体报道对移民态度的影响。它将法国电视中关于移民的报道数据与2013年至2017年的个体面板数据相结合，该数据记录了受访者偏好的电视频道及其对移民的态度。分析聚焦于个体内部随时间的变化，解决了意识形态上对频道的自我选择问题。我们发现，移民报道的增加使态度极化，最初持温和态度的个体更可能报告极端正面和负面的态度。这种极化主要由移民问题显著性的增加驱动，这重新激活了先前存在的偏见，而非来自偏见性新闻消费的说服效应。(JEL D83, D91, J15, J18, L82)

articles.title_en: Changes in Family Structure and Welfare Participation since the 1960s: The Role of Legal Services
articles.title_cn: 自1960年代以来家庭结构与福利参与的变化：法律服务的作用
articles.abstract_en: This paper evaluates the effects of the War on Poverty's legal services program (LSP), which provided subsidized legal assistance to poor communities, focusing on divorce and welfare access. We use a difference-in-difference (DiD) research design based on the program's rollout from 1965 to 1975. We find temporary increases in the rate of new divorces and persistent increases in welfare participation, consistent with LSP activities. We find increases in nonmarital birth rates that stem from falling marriage rates rather than rising birth rates. Expanded access to legal institutions thus contributed directly and indirectly to changes in family structure in the 1960s. (JEL H53, I32, I38, J12, K36)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了“向贫困宣战”中的法律服务项目（LSP）的效果，该项目为贫困社区提供补贴性法律援助，重点关注离婚和福利获取。我们采用基于该项目从1965年至1975年逐步推广的差分中的差分（DiD）研究设计。我们发现，新离婚率出现了暂时性上升，而福利参与则持续增加，这与LSP的活动相符。我们还发现非婚生育率的上升源于结婚率的下降而非生育率的上升。因此，法律机构准入的扩大直接和间接地促进了1960年代以来家庭结构的变化。（JEL H53, I32, I38, J12, K36）

articles.title_en: Wealth Tax Mobility and Tax Coordination
articles.title_cn: 财富税流动性与税收协调
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of decentralized wealth taxation on mobility and the effectiveness of tax coordination at mitigating tax competition. We exploit the reintroduction of the Spanish wealth tax, after which all regions except Madrid levied positive tax rates. We find the mobility responses to wealth taxes are within the range of prior estimates with respect to income taxes. However, wealth tax mobility responses generate losses to personal income tax revenues that are six times larger than the direct losses to wealth taxes. Madrid could achieve higher total regional revenues by agreeing to a harmonized positive tax rate. (JEL D31, G51, H24, H71, H73, H77)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了分散化财富税对流动性的影响以及税收协调在缓解税收竞争方面的有效性。我们利用了西班牙财富税的重启，此后除马德里外的所有地区都征收了正税率。我们发现，财富税的流动性反应在所得税的先前估计范围内。然而，财富税的流动性反应导致的个人所得税收入损失是财富税直接损失的六倍。马德里通过同意统一的正常税率，可以实现更高的地区总收入。(JEL D31, G51, H24, H71, H73, H77)

articles.title_cn: 职业与代际收入流动性
articles.abstract_en: This paper uses census microdata linked with tax records to quantify the contribution of occupations to intergenerational income mobility. We document substantial segregation into occupations by parental income. Children of high-income parents are significantly more likely to pursue high-paying and more desirable occupations. Since parents may pass on their occupations to their children, we further describe patterns of intergenerational occupational following and show they vary substantially across occupations, with low-income occupations showing more persistence across generations on average. Yet, occupational persistence plays a limited role for income mobility, explaining only 10 percent of the income rank-rank relationship. (JEL J13, J16, J31, J62)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用与税务记录关联的人口普查微观数据，量化职业对代际收入流动性的贡献。我们记录了按父母收入划分的职业隔离现象。高收入父母的子女更有可能从事高薪且更理想的职业。由于父母可能将职业传给子女，我们进一步描述了代际职业跟随的模式，并显示这些模式在不同职业间差异显著，平均而言，低收入职业在代际间的持续性更强。然而，职业持续性对收入流动性的作用有限，仅解释了收入排名-排名关系的10%。(JEL J13, J16, J31, J62)

articles.title_en: Betting on the House: Subjective Expectations and Market Choices
articles.title_cn: 押注房产：主观预期与市场选择
articles.abstract_en: Home price expectations play a central role in macroeconomics and finance. However, there is little direct evidence on their effect on market choices. We provide causal evidence using a large-scale, high-stakes field experiment in the United States. We sent letters about home price trends to 57,910 homeowners who listed their homes. These letters contained randomized information creating nondeceptive, exogenous variation in home price expectations. Consistent with economic theory, higher expectations reduced selling probability. Behavior was highly elastic: a 1 percentage point increase in expectations caused a 2.63 percentage point reduction in the probability of selling the property within 12 weeks. (JEL C93, D83, D84, R31)
articles.abstract_cn: 房价预期在宏观经济学和金融学中扮演核心角色。然而，关于其对市场选择影响的直接证据很少。我们通过在美国进行的一项大规模、高风险的实地实验提供了因果证据。我们向57,910名挂牌出售房屋的房主发送了关于房价趋势的信件。这些信件包含随机化信息，从而在房价预期中产生了非欺骗性的外生变异。与经济理论一致，更高的预期降低了出售概率。行为具有高度弹性：预期每增加1个百分点，导致在12周内出售房产的概率降低2.63个百分点。(JEL C93, D83, D84, R31)

articles.title_en: Changes in Nutrient Intake at Retirement
articles.title_cn: 退休时营养摄入的变化
articles.abstract_en: Prior research finds food expenditure decreases at retirement, which suggests households are inadequately saving. In contrast, other evidence shows that direct measures of food intake are unaffected by exiting the labor force. Using a wide array of data sources and methodologies, we find that food intake falls at retirement, including: declines in caloric and nutrient intake in cross-sectional datasets spanning 40 years, a decrease in caloric intake using longitudinal data, and a drop in a food intake index that relates diet composition to permanent income. We discuss the implications of these results in the context of life-cycle models of consumption. (JEL D15, G51, I12, J26)
articles.abstract_cn: 先前的研究发现，退休时食品支出减少，这表明家庭储蓄不足。相比之下，其他证据显示，直接测量的食物摄入量不受退出劳动力市场的影响。利用广泛的数据来源和方法，我们发现退休时食物摄入量下降，包括：跨越40年的横截面数据集中热量和营养摄入的下降，使用纵向数据时热量摄入的减少，以及一个将饮食构成与永久收入相关联的食物摄入指数的下降。我们在消费的生命周期模型背景下讨论了这些结果的含义。(JEL D15, G51, I12, J26)

articles.title_en: Digital Information Provision and Behavior Change: Lessons from Six Experiments in East Africa
articles.title_cn: 数字信息提供与行为改变：来自东非六项实验的启示
articles.abstract_en: While some studies suggest mobile phone–based information programs change behavior; others find no effect. We evaluate six text message agricultural extension programs, collectively covering 128,000 farmers. A meta-analysis finds a 1.22-fold increase in the odds of adoption of recommended practices (95 percent CI: 1.16, 1.29). We cannot reject similar impacts across experiments. Impacts are increased by message repetition, but not by providing more granular information, using behavioral framings, or complementing texts with phone calls. There is little evidence of message fatigue or crowd-out. Despite modest absolute impacts detectable only with large samples or meta-analysis, texts are inexpensive enough to be cost-effective. (JEL D83, D91, L96, O13, Q12, Q16)
articles.abstract_cn: 虽然一些研究表明基于手机的信息项目能改变行为，但其他研究未发现效果。我们评估了六个短信农业推广项目，共覆盖128,000名农民。一项荟萃分析发现，采纳推荐实践的几率增加了1.22倍（95%置信区间：1.16，1.29）。我们不能拒绝各实验间影响相似的假设。信息重复会增强影响，但提供更细粒度的信息、使用行为框架或通过电话补充短信并不会增强影响。几乎没有证据表明存在信息疲劳或挤出效应。尽管绝对影响不大，只有通过大样本或荟萃分析才能检测到，但短信成本足够低，具有成本效益。（JEL D83, D91, L96, O13, Q12, Q16）
